gates.name: phospho_pocket
gates.note: pS7 (LARP1 S548) in the 14-3-3 gamma phosphate pocket (native K50,R57,R132,Y133 = input B49,56,131,132); evidence binding_site, chemistry, peptide_analog (6S9K SEP139 phosphate contacts all four). Partner narrowed from all of chain A to A:7 so the gate checks the register, not just peptide presence; >=2 of 4 so unmodified (no phosphate) models are not failed on side-chain length alone

gates.name: motif
gates.note: pS-L-P core (A7-A9) all in contact with 14-3-3 gamma; evidence motif (Yaffe 1997, PMID 9428519), peptide_analog (6S9K pS-L-P bound in groove)

gates.name: assembled
gates.note: sanity: peptide docked on the receptor

notes: no rmsd gate: no public LARP1:14-3-3 complex; 6S9K is a different peptide, used as the register prior in phospho_pocket
